expected_symptom: Amplification shader with an empty-struct payload fails DXIL validation with 'payload size N is greater than declared size of 0 bytes' instead of compiling (Vulkan allows an absent/empty task payload).
history: always-repro'd (v1.5.2010..v1.9.2607; v1.4.1907 predates SM 6.5 / mesh shaders, invalid-probe)
reviewed_by: gpt-5.3-codex (independent batch-019 step-10 review; applied selectively at collation)
summary: Empty-struct amplification-shader payload (struct Payload {}; DispatchMesh(...,pld)) still fails DXIL validation on main (89e2f98e2) exactly as reported: 'payload size 4 is greater than declared size of 0 bytes'. Always-repro'd since mesh shaders shipped (v1.5.2010) through v1.9.2607; v1.4.1907 predates as_6_5. Root cause identified by source read: ValidateAsIntrinsics in DxilValidation.cpp measures the payload POINTER's alloc size (constant 4 on DXIL's 32-bit-pointer datalayout) instead of the pointee struct, so the check only ever fires when the real struct size is below 4 bytes -- i.e. only for an empty struct. Confirmed with two controls: a normal 4-byte payload compiles clean, and -Vd (skip validation) on the empty payload also compiles clean and emits a declared size of 0 in the DXIL metadata, isolating the defect to this one validator comparison.
title: Amplification shader: support for empty payload
